deskyard volume remove: remove a volume

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] volume remove NAME [--delete-files]

Removes a volume no computer grants any more; its folder is kept unless
--delete-files.

Arguments:
  NAME       string      required  volume name

Options:
  --delete-files       also delete the volume's files
  --server NAME        the server to manage (see `deskyard server list`);
                       default: the server -c SERVER/COMPUTER names, else the
                       default server

Prints: a confirmation line

Examples:
  deskyard volume remove photos

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
